problem:
What is the sum of the leading entries of the $1$st and $4$th rows in the matrix $A,$ given below?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & -4 & 1 & 0 \\ -9 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 8 & 9 & -8 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 9 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry. 

Therefore, the leading entries of the $1$st and $4$th rows of  $A$ are $-4$ and $9$, respectively.

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & -4 & 1 & 0 \\ -9 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 8 & 9 & -8 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 9 & -1\end{aligned}].
$$

So, the answer is $-4+9=5.$
